question: This passage is mainly about:

options.text: the rainfall from June to September in MP
the varieties of soybean grown in MP
the impact of rain on the soybean crop in MP
the growth of soybean in MP

solution:
The correct answer is** 'the impact of rain on the soybean crop in MP.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is mainly talking about the percentage and effects of rainfall on the soybean crop in different areas of MP.
 
 
• Passage मुख्य रूप से मध्य प्रदेश के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में सोयाबीन की फसल पर प्रतिशत और वर्षा के प्रभाव के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
 
 
• Therefore, this passage is mainly about the impact of rain on the soybean crop in MP.
 
• Hence, the correct option is 'the impact of rain on the soybean crop in MP.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 
• The meaning of the word** 'impact' **is a marked effect or influence. (**'Impact'** शब्द का अर्थ एक चिह्नित प्रभाव या प्रभाव है।)

 
 
• **Example**: *Our regional measures have had a significant** impact** on unemployment.*
